page_title: HAM 0-1 WOL | Hamburger SV v Wolfsburg 25/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Merlin Polzin is stunned as referee Martin Petersen shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
90+4' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) unleashes a tremendous shot from distance, but it crashes against the left post! If it had flown more to the right it would have been a cracker!
90+4' A quickly taken corner by Hamburger SV.
90+4' The resulting set piece from Hamburger SV is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+4' Fabio Balde (Hamburger) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
90+3' Fabio Balde (Hamburger) sends a cross into the box, but Kamil Grabara comes off his line to gather the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Martin Petersen had an easy-decision to make.
90' The attendance is 57000.
89' Hamburger SV fail to score from a corner as Kamil Grabara (Wolfsburg) leaps to collect the ball.
88' Merlin Polzin prepares a substitution. Daniel Elfadli is replaced by Immanuel Pherai (Hamburger).
88' The substitution has been made. Guilherme Ramos (Hamburger) has replaced Nicolas Capaldo.
87' A pass into the penalty area from Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger) is intercepted by the defence.

86' A precise low pass is received by Miro Muheim (Hamburger), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
85' Substitution. Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) on for Sael Kumbedi.
83' A spell of possession for Hamburger SV in an attempt to control the game.
81' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the middle of the goal, but Kamil Grabara pulls off a fantastic save to deny him.
80' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.

79' Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
78' Hamburger SV seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
77' Substitution. William Mikelbrencis did his best and is replaced by Fabio Balde (Hamburger).
76' Paul Simonis appears to have said too much and referee Martin Petersen comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
75' Hamburger SV hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
74' William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
71' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Hamburger SV.
70' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
70' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
70' The referee points to the corner flag and Hamburger SV will take a corner.
67' Paul Simonis has decided to substitute Jonas Wind and he is replaced by Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg).
67' The referee allows time for a substitution. Christian Eriksen will be replaced by Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg).
67' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
65' Hamburger SV will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
64' Merlin Polzin decides to make a substitution. Albert Sambi Lokonga will be replaced by Fabio Vieira (Hamburger).
64' We are about to witness a substitution. Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger) is replacing Ransford Konigsdorffer.
63' Wolfsburg control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
62' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Hamburger SV.
61' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 4:9.

59' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Kamil Grabara shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
56' Paul Simonis has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bence Dardai (Wolfsburg) replacing Vini Souza.
56' The referee signals a substitution. Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Mohamed Amoura.

55' Close! Aaron Zehnter (Wolfsburg) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
54' Wolfsburg hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
52' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
51' Hamburger SV quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
50' Hamburger SV take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
49' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
48' Wolfsburg are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+3' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
45+1' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the left side of the goal, but it's not enough to beat Kamil Grabara who easily stops the effort.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. That's a penalty to Hamburger SV! They have a good chance to score now.
44' Some neat passing and movement from Hamburger SV as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
42' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Wolfsburg was in an offside position.
40' The Hamburger SV players are exchanging some short passes.
39' Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
37' Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
34' Wolfsburg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
33' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
32' The referee signals a corner kick to Wolfsburg.
32' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the right post.
31' Total attempts – 3:1.
29' Great teamplay by Hamburger SV as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
28' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
26' Wolfsburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
24' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Vini Souza (Wolfsburg) was quite harsh and Martin Petersen didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
24' Neat passing move from Hamburger SV in order to create new attacking opportunities.
21' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.

20' Hamburger SV players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
18' Hamburger SV failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
15' 0 - 1 Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Daniel Heuer Fernandes with a strike into the left side of the goal. He makes it 0:1.
14' Hamburger SV enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
14' 58:42 – the latest ball possession ratio.
11' The Wolfsburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
8' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Hamburger SV.
6' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Daniel Heuer Fernandes (Hamburger), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
5' Hamburger SV get a corner.
3' The ball is out of play. Hamburger SV will have a chance to score from a corner.
2' The Hamburger SV players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Wolfsburg will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Martin Petersen.
